gloss: to pull out; to extract; to remove

definitions.gloss: to pull out; to extract; to remove
definitions.explanation: To physically remove something by pulling it out of where it is embedded or contained.

definitions.gloss: to steal; to pilfer; to skim off
definitions.explanation: To secretly take something from a larger quantity without being noticed.

examples.japanese: {雑草|ざっそう}を{抜|ぬ}き{取|と}る。
{古|ふる}いクギを{抜|ぬ}き{取|と}った。
examples.english: I pulled out the old nails.

examples.japanese: {医者|いしゃ}が{傷口|きずぐち}から{破片|はへん}を{慎重|しんちょう}に{抜|ぬ}き{取|と}った。
examples.english: The doctor carefully extracted the fragment from the wound.

examples.japanese: {売上金|うりあげきん}を{抜|ぬ}き{取|と}る。
examples.english: To skim off from the sales proceeds.

examples.japanese: {在庫|ざいこ}から{商品|しょうひん}を{抜|ぬ}き{取|と}る{社員|しゃいん}がいた。
examples.english: There was an employee pilfering goods from the inventory.

examples.japanese: {検査|けんさ}のために{製品|せいひん}をいくつか{抜|ぬ}き{取|と}った。
examples.english: I pulled out a few products for inspection.

notes:
A compound verb from {抜|ぬ}く (to pull out) + {取|と}る (to take). The {取|と}る component adds the nuance of taking possession of what is removed.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {雑草|ざっそう}を{抜|ぬ}き{取|と}る: to pull out weeds
- {釘|くぎ}を{抜|ぬ}き{取|と}る: to pull out nails
- {栓|せん}を{抜|ぬ}き{取|と}る: to pull out a plug/cork
- {抜|ぬ}き{取|と}り{検査|けんさ}: spot check, random sampling

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {抜|ぬ}く: to pull out — simpler verb without the taking nuance; broader in meaning
- {引|ひ}き{抜|ぬ}く: to pull out, uproot — emphasizes the pulling force needed
- {取|と}り{除|のぞ}く: to remove, eliminate — focuses on getting rid of something rather than the physical pulling motion

RELATED WORDS:
{抜|ぬ}き{取|と}り{検査|けんさ} (spot check, random inspection) is a very common compound noun in quality control and manufacturing contexts.
